text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head to the dance studio at Mayano
Top Gun's
request.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: One, two! One, two! Now...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Leopard pose! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Darn it. Why can't I get it right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're here! Hear me out!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The dance teacher said I'm too young for
sexy
choreography!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Said I can't properly show off the dance
until I'm
taller and curvier!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Talk about rude, right?! I'm totally sexy
enough!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Talk about rude, right?! I'm totally sexy
enough!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's show them what you can do!
Why not try adding a bit of cutene...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yay! ♪ I knew you'd take my side,
Trainer!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's show them what you can do!
Why not try adding a bit of cutene...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Heh! I'm totally curvy already! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And I can just stand on my tippy toes to
look
taller!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Like thi—whoa!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Crash landing! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Th-that never happened, okay?! Let me
try again!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: I don't think you need to force yo...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: O-oh my!
choice_data_list: Just dance as the Mayano you are.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Do you really mean that?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's like you're saying you like me just
the way I
am! ☆ Aaah!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You must really love me, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There seems to have been a bit of a 
misunderstanding, but whatever the
case,
Mayano Top Gun is back in good
spirits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, she continues to practice, even
managing to persuade the dance
teacher to let
her perform how she
wants.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me you think so too! Are you
saying I'm
too young for the grown-up
dances?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I try to explain to her that playing up to
her cute side would add an extra
dimension to her appeal
than just a sexy
dance.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So what you're saying is... "mature"
doesn't even
begin to describe me!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: That's it, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
In that case, you have to help me come
up with
new choreography! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
We need to come up with a dance that
shows off
all of my charms! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
With your help, I'm sure we can come up
with a
dance that'll knock my teacher's
socks off!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm ready to take off! Adulthood, here I
come! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I spend some time helping
Mayano
Top Gun come up with her new
choreography.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She earns high praise from her dance
teacher
when she performs a few days
later.
